verdict.rationale: The REST API schedules outbound calls, including an option to bypass dialing windows, and has an endpoint to import a phone number from your own SIP trunk. Webhooks report call events, and the docs say existing numbers can handle incoming and outgoing calls via SIP trunk or forwarding. However, the only number endpoint shown imports numbers rather than provisioning new ones, and inbound setup is described as provider/PBX-side configuration rather than an API capability. Missing for 10: API provisioning or purchase of new numbers, API-driven inbound call routing and handling, and independent hands-on corroboration.
